lead: An inline-HTML run is assertable as a *value*, which lets a case count one rather than read it.
body: A run is a statement and an anonymous function's block body is a statement list, so `Core\Out::capture(fn (): void => { ?>text<?nvs })` lowers, and the `Core\Cli\Text` it answers takes `as string`. `Core\Str::compare($t as string, "text")` is the comparison — the only way to put a raw span and an `echo` of the same literal side by side.
